newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures barely changed Monday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures barely changed Monday.

text.p: U.S. energy futures were barely changed in after-hours trade Monday, while traders rolled the expiring crude oil contract for May in the next month, traders said.
"They're mostly buying May and rolling them into June," a trader said.

The crude oil futures contract for May, which expires Tuesday, traded off three cents a barrel on ACCESS at $20.35 a barrel, with a light 350 lots changing hands in the front month and 852 traded overall.

May gasoline was unchanged from the settle at 62.80 cents a gallon. The contract ended strongly on the day session, up 1.31 cents, amid rumors that Citgo had shut a gasoline-making unit at its Corpus Christi, Texas refinery.
Citgo declined comment and gasoline volumes on ACCESS stood at 35 lots in May and 40 total.
After-hours, NYMEX May heating oil eased 0.03 cents to 55.45 cents while volume reached 74 lots in the front-month and 101 overall.
